fields.description: Issue includes an editorial condemning alleged police brutality following the arrest of Charlie Haynes after the shooting death of Miami police officer J. Franklin Beckham, and argues for due process. Other pieces discuss proposals for a Miami Beach boardwalk in Lummus Park and the need to adjust restrictions; commentary on bank withdrawals and local banking stability; criticism of high-interest lending and utility practices; complaints about dirty, inadequate streetcar service; letters to the editor on fire insurance rates and library funding; and a report promoting new home construction activity in Coral Gables.
